label: Internal Quality Assurer
coverage: Source-checked advertisements in a monitored sample, not all UK vacancies or funded positions.
method: Source-matched job identity and current application control. Reviewed provider pages may have an unknown closing date. Record expires is a maximum 48-hour verification-validity limit, shortened by a credible published close; it is not an invented closing date. Only comparable explicit GBP annual full-time pay is used. Programme associations require role-specific evidence. Organisations may be direct providers or recruitment advertisers.
